And therefore the שולחן ערוך פסקנס explicitly in סימן ר״ג סעיף ג׳ that you say האדמה on bananas, because the roots remain from year to year and therefore and and and only the roots remain from year to year, but the trunk does not, and therefore that is a האדמה.
